Data:Gather.garden.d.summer.json.startdescription: Moth orchid is soft as velvet to the touch; except when it changes.

Data:Gather.garden.empty.hint.json.label: Quiet Seasons
Data:Gather.garden.empty.hint.json.startdescription: The earth is quiet - not barren, only sleeping. [Harvesting is possible in a different season.]

Data:Gather.garden.g.numa.json.startdescription: Do grapes taste different when plucked in Numa? Perhaps we only imagine it.

Data:Gather.garden.g.spring.json.startdescription: Pluck the grapes from the vine.

Data:Gather.garden.g.summer.json.startdescription: Pluck the grapes from the vine.

Data:Gather.garden.h.numa.json.label: Numa:
Data:Gather.garden.h.numa.json.startdescription: Gather herbs for healing. In Numa they flourish feverishly...

Data:Gather.garden.needs.ability.hint.js.label: Exertion?
Data:Gather.garden.needs.ability.hint.js.startdescription: Harvest takes effort as well as knowledge. [Add a Soul card.]

Data:Gather.garden.needs.skill.hint.json.label: Wisdom?
Data:Gather.garden.needs.skill.hint.json.startdescription: The gardens of Hush House hold plants with many virtues - for those with the wisdom to recognise them. [Add a suitable Skill.]

Data:Gather.garden.night.hint.json.startdescription: Night-gardening is more atmospheric than practical. I should come back tomorrow.

Data:Gather.garden.p.autumn.json.startdescription: Fragrant pears, soft in the hand.

Data:Gather.garden.p.numa.json.label: Numa:
Data:Gather.garden.p.numa.json.startdescription: Pyrus auricalcinus. In Numa it develops quickly - the boughs of the tree bend with the fruit.

Data:Gather.garden.p.summer.json.startdescription: Fragrant pears, soft in the hand.

Data:Gather.garden.plot.key.json.startdescription: A corner of something metallic protrudes from the soil...
Data:Gather.garden.plot.key.json.desc: Once again, here's the Key to Hush House, half-buried in the garden.

Data:Gather.garden.v.autumn.json.startdescription: Carrots, tomatoes, marrows, and blessed onions - all the unsung heroes of the stew-pot.

Data:Gather.garden.v.numa.json.startdescription: Carrots, tomatoes, marrows, and blessed onions - all the unsung heroes of the stew-pot. In Numa they flourish fast, but there is something odd about their taste.

Data:Gather.garden.v.summer.json.startdescription: Carrots, tomatoes, marrows, and blessed onions - all the unsung heroes of the stew-pot.

Data:Gather.garden.x.numa.json.startdescription: The History Plant has risen! Gather its blooms - all the more plentiful in Numa!

Data:Gather.garden.x.summer.json.startdescription: The History Plant has risen! Gather its blooms!

Data:Gather.moor.autumn.json.startdescription: The last leaves toss and scutter.
Data:Gather.moor.autumn.json.desc: Unexpected finds in the folds of earth and sky.

Data:Gather.moor.night.hint.json.startdescription: At night? I'll fall off something, into something, or both. Tomorrow is soon enough.

Data:Gather.moor.numa.json.startdescription: Is it wise to walk on the moors in this season? Let's find out.
Data:Gather.moor.numa.json.desc: Much is lost, but much remains...

Data:Gather.moor.spring.json.startdescription: The gorse is bright on the land's nape.
Data:Gather.moor.spring.json.desc: Unexpected finds in the folds of earth and sky.

Data:Gather.moor.summer.json.desc: Unexpected finds in the folds of earth and sky.

Data:Gather.moor.winter.json.desc: Unexpected finds in the folds of earth and sky.

Data:Gather.nests.autumn.json.startdescription: Fierce yellow eyes watch my every move.

Data:Gather.nests.key.json.desc: A familiar iron key is caught in a crevice.

Data:Gather.nests.night.hint.json.startdescription: I am quite clearly not intending to climb the cliffs of Brancrug Isle in the middle of the night. I'm just speculating about the possibility.

Data:Gather.nests.numa.json.desc: Much is lost, but much remains...

Data:Gather.well.json.label: Draw up Water
Data:Gather.well.json.startdescription: Lower the bucket creaking into the dark.
Data:Gather.well.json.desc: A little water sploshes on to the stones of the well to nourish the mosses there.

Data:Gather.well.key.json.label: Draw up Water
Data:Gather.well.key.json.desc: A familiar iron key nestles in the bucket.

Data:Gather.well.numa.json.label: Draw up Water
Data:Gather.well.numa.json.desc: Water in the season of Numa is almost the same as water in any other season.

Data:Gervinite.json.Label: Gervinite
Data:Gervinite.json.Desc: An alloy equivalent in some respects to the clockmaker's invar - but instead of a constant weight, it retains the same origin in every history.

xexts.scrutiny: Whatever that means, it meant it. [There is a Scholar-level Knock recipe that can craft this with glass, and a Scholar-level Sky recipe that can craft it with metal.]
